items.title: Pay coworking invoice for December 2026
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Invoice date is Sat 21 Nov 2026. Under § 187(1) BGB the day of the event (invoice date) is not counted, so the 14-day period starts 22 Nov 2026. 14 days later lands on Sat 5 Dec 2026 (§ 188(1) BGB). Since 5 Dec 2026 is a Saturday, under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 7 Dec 2026.

warnings: The IBAN printed (DE72 3705 0198 0005 5778 80) is well-formed and matches the usual German company format, but ownership was not independently verified; confirm the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory account-name check before paying.
The letter warns that “Late payment may pause your access card” — a mild pressure tactic typical of routine invoices, not necessarily a scam sign, but worth noting.
